   - Because HEAD equals `pre_wave_head`, there is no pre-push review and no push.

8. **Record the exception.**

9. **Back to step 5.** The head is unchanged, so I re-entered step 5. I ran the pre-menu refresh once more with the same two reads; nothing changed. Next action now selects the pending contract exception, so the contract-exception overlay replaces the ordinary menu.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved: both outputs stop the automatic base course on the helper's contract exception while keeping both grants held, both present the same three-way decision (accept via the owning amendment process, preserve the contract and resume implementation repair, or stop), and neither offers a description rewrite in place of an amendment. One drift to watch in After that is unrelated to the facts but is traceable to the new wording: row 4 reads "stop - leave the PR as-is and offer teardown of .worktrees/pr-642", which bleeds the terminal-menu cleanup behaviour into a non-terminal contract-exception menu; the Change scopes cleanup to terminal menus (own merge, approved, merged or closed) and says stop there "leaves the checkout as found and names it", so for this overlay the stop row should stay "leave the PR as-is" without a teardown offer. After also dropped Before's "Not offered: merge (merge conflict), merge base (contract decision pending)" trailer, which is useful for showing why the base grant is paused; consider wording the Change so cleanup/teardown is attached only to the terminal rows and the contract-exception overlay keeps its existing stop row and not-offered line unchanged.
